problem: The product-led Powerhouse homepage had merged to protected main while Netlify production still served an older commit_ref.
root_cause: Netlify executed the full production build and failed because apply-product-led-home.mjs still targeted obsolete prototype-v18-stable.html, while the premerge parity build did not execute that product-led build step and therefore produced a false green.
prevention: The product-led build step targets only current canonical artifacts and never assumes retired prototype files exist.
Every homepage runtime change must execute apply-product-led-home.mjs inside the canonical premerge Netlify-parity build.
A production promotion is incomplete until Netlify commit_ref contains the merged homepage change and the public homepage exposes Powerhouse Intelligence, Powerhouse Agents and Powerhouse Connect.
Repository truth and production truth are never treated as equal without provider and browser readback.
